    "(", QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:QuoteLineType, ")"),
    IF(
        QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:QuoteLineType = "Quantity Increase",

            NOT(ISBLANK(QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:LineDescription)),
            " ",
            ""
        ),
        "(", QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:QuoteLineType, ")"),
        IF(
           QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:QuoteLineType = "Quantity Reduction",

            CONCAT(QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:LineDescription + " " + QuoteLineGroup:QuoteLine:RateDetails,"")
